LESSON: SELECTED VERSES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.3: Selected verses

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Selected verses. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can the teachings of the verses reform the society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application
3. explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building
4. apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives
5. appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SELECTED VERSES
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Selected verses helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SELECTED VERSES
Study Selected verses like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment

What this means
In this part you learn to read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Selected verses” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected verses in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives

What this means
In this part you learn to apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Selected verses” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 5: Appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected verses in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the teachings of the selected verses as sourced from the Quran. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Selected verses is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Selected verses” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Selected verses in your own words. (skill: explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building)

Example 4: Show how “Selected verses” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: apply the teachings of the selected verses in their daily lives)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Selected verses to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment.
3. Practise this skill: explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application.
4. Practise this skill: explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Selected verses from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Selected verses: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Selected verses?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can the teachings of the verses reform the society?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Selected verses means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment.
5. Be able to: explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
